Name: Expressive Elf Ears FS and Overlay
Author: GoblinHours
Description:
[b][u]
[/u][/b][b][size=5][u]If you use my mod in a collection I will look upon you with contempt[/u][/size]


[color=#ff7700]Get Floppin Baby!![/color][/b]
[size=3]This mod adds in a set of elf ears to the player sprite that flop around when using tools or showing emotion. I drew all these dang ears myself and because the scale is so small they look a bit wonky on frames.[/size]

[size=4]Code for overlay update done by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/8096551]Frozentas[/url] (thank you so much for the help!!!!)
Fashion Sense update done by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/157597893]Iceprincess98[/url] (thank you so much for the help!!!)
[/size][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SD38se3bNcA&feature=youtu.be]
[size=6]Demo Video[/size][/url]

[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]You can wear hats with these ears, but they look a bit odd sometimes[/size]
[*][size=3]This should work with any skin tone and hair (any mod that changes the default player sprite's skin tone will look off, but the ears can easily be edited to fix this)[/size]
[*][size=3]If you have issues I've included a blank ear asset that you can edit and do with as you please[/size]
[/list][color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Known Issues[/b] [/size][/color][color=#ffff00][size=3](Default Overlay Version)[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=3]Ears disappear when swimming[/size]
[*][size=3]Ears clip with some hats, but only sometimes. Don't really know why[/size]
[*][size=3]Ears move when fishing. Personally, I find this cute, but it does look a bit strange[/size]
[/list][color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Known Issues[/b][/size][/color][size=3][color=#ffff00] (Fashion Sense Version)
[/color][/size][list]
[*]Ears are underneath hats all the time. Can look a bit off with some hats.
[*]When slowed by a slime the ears don't change color with the rest of the body
[*]Ears don't line up right on the kissing animation

[/list]Mods seen in previews:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7600]Pink Tools[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5705]Yellog's Walls and Floors[/url]﻿
A personal furniture mod made with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5444]Industrial Furniture Set[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6351]Yellog's Furniture[/url]﻿ (I will never upload or share this mod, it's is for my personal use only)
